perf_validation.approach: per-kit windowed sc_positions PK-range read + bbox/geoDistance open-address match, every 5 min, 15-min idempotent lookback
perf_validation.measurement: READ-ONLY prod CH Cloud (2026-08-10): sc_positions total ~254.96M rows (2026-04-12..2026-08-10, unbounded, not >1B). Per-kit windowed read (busiest kit): 15-min window ~122ms/6,464 fixes; 60-min ~124ms/31,391 fixes -> index-bounded (ORDER BY (kit_mapping,timestamp_utc)), not table-size-sensitive. Fleet ~142 active kits/15min, ~159/1h. Est per-cycle sweep ~150 kits x ~120ms read + bbox match << 300s (5-min) budget. Aggregates/timings only; no raw rows/identifiers.

correction_2026_08_11.finding: The earlier 'per-kit ~120ms, index-bounded' measured ONLY the sc_positions windowed read, not the full match. The full per-kit query re-scanned zod.public_hotlist_address (311M rows; ORDER BY id, so the hotlist_id join cannot prune) + clarity.hotlist FINAL, once PER KIT -> ~2.5-12s/kit (Cloud-variance) reading 311M+ rows. At fleet scale (~150 kits every 5 min) that overruns the cycle and hammers CH.
correction_2026_08_11.fix: A+B. (A) Enumerate open-order addresses once per ORG via new ScoutOpenOrderAddressesQuery. (B) Cache that per-org set 15 min. The per-kit matcher (ScoutCheckInMatchQuery) now injects the cached set as a CH values() literal (chunked at 2000 to stay under max_query_size) and reads only sc_positions -> no per-kit 311M scan. Row-for-row equivalence with the old combined query PROVEN against prod (kit jasonstephens / org 321316, 41/41 identical). Both query classes smoke-tested end-to-end vs real local CH.
